description:
## Functional specifications
Implement trusted normalized add/remove events and a capability-aware refresh Action callable by admins, authorized agents and workflows. A People-targeted refresh is scoped to Person plus connector; concrete provider capability determines how a complete result is obtained. Keep authorization inside the operation, not only the UI. Reconcile provider grants idempotently, preserve manual grants, fence refresh/event ordering and never revoke from incomplete snapshots. Record downstream wiring as deferred. Test unsupported providers, invalid identities, duplicate/stale events, partial pagination and provider errors.

## Files and ownership
Permissions; Engine reconciliation/API; Channels CommunicationBridge/Bridge capability APIs; new validated refresh Action; workflow and operation tests

## Action reuse assessment
New focused refresh Action reuses one Engine reconciliation operation and Channels provider boundary. BO/agent/workflow require trusted authorization. Agent allowlisting is deliberate, not automatic. No provider implementation in this issue.

## Tests to add before implementation / branches
Use the explicit scenarios in Functional specifications as acceptance tests; include denial, failure, concurrency and idempotency branches where applicable. Preserve existing passing assertions.

## Mocking plan
External transport/model/clock boundaries only; no blanket NodeRouter stubs.

## Documentation
docs/services/{engine,channels,workflows}.md; operation schemas/moduledocs

Execution requirements: planning only until assigned for implementation. Preserve existing uncommitted work and progress comments; do not infer completion from historical tests. Read AGENTS.md, docs/agent-tools.md, docs/WORKFLOW_AGENT.md, docs/action-reuse.md, docs/testing-approach.md and applicable service guides before affected work. Write immediate unit/integration/property regression tests BEFORE implementation. Mock only genuine external boundaries; keep internal domain paths real. Run isolated tests and mix q per issue; final precommit belongs to the dedicated final gate. New feature E2E authoring waits for zaq-emb.12. No commit/push authorization is implied.
title: [zaq-emb.6] Membership reconciliation and reusable refresh Action
